scoring_justification: Standard deviation recomputed from raw histogram data and compared to paper’s reported 340 eV within tolerance; internal consistency and shape sanity cross‑checks prevent trivial fabrication.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold standard deviation value for geometrical broadening at 135°
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: Sartori & Mainardi, Phil. Mag. B 69, 113 (1994), §3.2: “The standard deviation, σ, is thus 340 eV.”
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper’s Results section for the 135° geometry.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Value is the paper’s own reported result for the exact geometry the agent must simulate.

outputs.description: Monte Carlo simulation result for 135° geometry: standard deviation of the scattered photon energy distribution (eV), histogram counts (integers), and histogram bin edges (eV).

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes the standard deviation from the histogram, checks internal consistency, compares to the paper's 340 eV with tolerance, and may perform a shape test on the histogram.

steps.description: Recompute standard deviation from histogram and compare to paper value 340 eV
Check reported standard_deviation matches recomputed from histogram
Basic shape checks: non-empty histogram, increasing edges, peak near expected energy ~50 keV
